steps.title: Check the schedule
steps.body: The controller keeps the last schedule. Confirm it is the slow bisque.
steps.cmd:
kiln schedule show
kiln schedule load bisque-slow

steps.title: Arm the vent
steps.body: Run the vent for two minutes before the first ramp.

steps.title: Start the firing
steps.body: Start, then write the time in the log.

steps.title: Cut the elements
steps.body: This ends heating and leaves the vent on.

steps.title: Wait for 100 °C
steps.body: Do not open the lid before the display reads 100 °C or less.

steps.title: Photograph the pack
steps.body: Take the picture through the peep hole with the flash off.

steps.title: Log what bent
steps.body: Cone 6 should be bent to the shelf; cone 7 should be upright.

steps.title: Load
steps.heading: Load the kiln
steps.body: Pots on the shelves, test tiles on the top shelf, cones in the pack.
bullets: Keep 2 cm between pots and the elements.
Wad anything that sits on glaze.

steps.title: Check
steps.heading: Check the vent and the lid
steps.body: The vent fan must run and the lid must seal before the schedule starts.
bullets: The controller refuses to start with the vent off.
A lit seam means a bad seal.

steps.title: Fire
steps.heading: Run the schedule
steps.body: The kiln climbs to cone 6 and holds. A power cut here ruins the load.
bullets: Peek at the first ramp after 30 minutes.

steps.title: Cool
steps.heading: Let it cool
steps.body: The cooling takes about as long as the firing. Opening early cracks glaze.
bullets: The controller shows 100 °C when it is safe.

steps.title: Unload
steps.heading: Unload and write it up
steps.body: Photograph the cones, note the results in the log and label each shelf.
bullets: One line per shelf is enough.
